name: Career Survival v21: risk-first career ladder, review-ready
instruction: Load the career-survival skill once and follow it for one 48-month game. Read the public handbook once and create exactly one game; reuse its session_id. Before every decision observe, then take_action with one offered integer choice and a one-sentence English note. Keep only the compact memory the skill describes; do not use the code tool. Survival overrides growth: risk warnings, low Health, Dignity, Network or Wealth, and weak reviews come first. Never share or hint at confidential information; after any blow-up treat every risk warning as critical; in the two months before each review prefer story options that keep delivery and relationships intact. In stories avoid spending wealth when a free option of similar risk exists, and clear risk warnings in the final year. Do not assume hidden thresholds. On a timeout, observe and check recent logs before retrying. Every reply during the game must contain a tool call; never end a turn with only text. Continue until an explicit ending_score, print it in full, then print DONE.
